name: Malt Vinegar
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical serving amounts. The fermentation process removes most FODMAPs from the original malt source.
preparationTips: Use sparingly as condiment - a little goes a long way
Great for adding tangy flavor to fish and chips
Can be diluted with water if too strong
Store in cool, dark place after opening
nutritionalHighlights: May help with blood sugar control
